image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is shown from a top-down perspective, resting on a bed of dry autumn leaves and small stones. The salamander has a glossy black body with vivid yellow spots and patches distributed across its back, head, and limbs. Its body is robust and cylindrical, with short, stout limbs visible. The skin appears smooth and moist, reflecting light. The head is broad and flattened, with small dark eyes visible. The tail is partially visible, extending behind the body.
